mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission (missionNo, car_id, goods_id, goods_type, quantity, totalWeight, totalVol, distance_km, total_minutes, elapsed_minutes, status, createTime, factory_id, dest_factory_id, route_id, need_id) VALUES (#{missionNo}, #{carId}, #{goodsId}, #{goodsType}, #{quantity}, #{totalWeight}, #{totalVol}, #{distanceKm}, #{totalMinutes}, #{elapsedMinutes}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{factoryId}, #{destFactoryId}, #{routeId}, #{needId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mission ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE mission SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mission WHERE status IN ('接单中', '装货中', '运输中', '卸货中') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
